
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/23539216" title="发布于 2026-11-03 19:59">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">AScript之字符串模板</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p data-first-child="" data-pid="iWJK_5f1">AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行引擎，版本1.8.1新增了字符串模板转化功能。</p>
<p data-first-child="" data-pid="iWJK_5f1">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="EUEmnwDj">我们来对比两种字符串模板方案：</p>
<p data-pid="EUEmnwDj">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="SFEBJOhR"><strong>方案一</strong></p>
<p data-pid="MdXfWlH-">比较常用的字符串模板方案，使用Replace替换变量。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>尊敬的 {userName}{userSex} 您好，祝您{userAge}岁生日快乐！</pre>
</div>
<p>转化逻辑如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模拟获取业务数据</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> user = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { Name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">张三</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Sex = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, Birthday = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> DateTime(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1990</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>), CreateTime = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> DateTime(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2026</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 计算模板中需要的变量</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> userName =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> user.Name;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> userSex = user.Sex == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> ? <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">女士</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> : <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">先生</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> useAge = (DateTime.Now.Year -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> user.Birthday.Year).ToString();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 替换模板中的变量</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = template.Replace(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{userName}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, userName).Replace(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{userSex}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, userSex).Replace(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{userAge}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, userAge);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 结果：尊敬的 张三先生 您好，祝您36岁生日快乐！</span></pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="2NMnNMo_">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="2NMnNMo_"><strong>方案二</strong></p>
<p data-pid="m_8dQ7fM">动态脚本转化模板，字符串中使用<code>${}</code>包含脚本块。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>尊敬的 ${user.Name}${user.Sex == 0 ? '女士' : '先生'} 您好，祝您${DateTime.Now.Year - user.Birthday.Year}岁生日快乐！</pre>
</div>
<p>转化逻辑如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模拟获取业务数据</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> user = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { Name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">张三</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Sex = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, Birthday = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> DateTime(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1990</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>), CreateTime = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> DateTime(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2026</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 注入业务数据</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> script.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, user);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 转化模板</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = script.Translate(template)?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Trim();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 结果：尊敬的 张三先生 您好，祝您36岁生日快乐！</span></pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="wSWz3dKk">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="wSWz3dKk"><strong>两个方案对比</strong></p>
<p data-pid="gl-kRpzg">方案一：代码与模板中的变量名需要保持一致，变量固定，模板中新增变量需要同步代码修改；</p>
<p data-pid="fINw-CJm">方案二：代码只需注入业务数据即可，不关心模板如何使用，后期维护非常灵活。</p>
<p data-pid="fINw-CJm">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="-ITk7GxS"><strong>高级应用</strong></p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="HuR-k435">脚本块中定义的变量和函数不会回写到上下文；</li>
<li data-pid="AZ1YyXTZ">当前脚本块可以调用前一个脚本块中定义的变量和函数；</li>
<li data-pid="RwGdZGZi"><code>${}</code>脚本块会将最后一条语句执行结果拼接到字符串中；</li>
<li data-pid="GwCI71jL"><code>@{}</code>脚本块只执行，不拼接结果，常用于变量计算或者函数定义。</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>@{
    int calcAge(DateTime birthday) {
        return DateTime.Now.Year - birthday.Year
    }
    var userSex = user.Sex == 0 ? '女士' : '先生';
    //var userAge = DateTime.Now.Year - user.Birthday.Year;
    //var userAge = calcAge(user.Birthday);
}
尊敬的 ${user.Name}${userSex} 您好，祝您${calcAge(user.Birthday)}岁生日快乐！</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="R55s9eiA">模板转化逻辑见&nbsp;<em>方案二</em>。</p>
<p class="ztext-empty-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="D1OlDLbC">大家在项目应用中是如何设计字符串模板的呢？</p>
<p class="ztext-empty-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="EyhgH0yV">nuget安装包：<code>install-package AScript</code></p>
<p data-pid="eAec5rsR">开源地址：</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="eAec5rsR"><a title="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank">https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript</a></li>
<li data-pid="eAec5rsR"><a title="https://github.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://github.com/rockey627/AScript" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank">https://github.com/rockey627/AScript</a></li>
</ul>
